subject.title: Add Tailscale Serve support for WSL gateways

question: Should generated WSL gateways officially support separately opt-in `gateway.auth.allowTailscale=true` as a core authorization path now that daemon and Serve administration remain root-owned?
rationale: This makes verified tailnet identity and ACL policy a lasting gateway access-control contract; implementation correctness and live proof cannot establish whether maintainers want to support that threat model.

options.title: Approve opt-in identity trust
options.body: Support the mode with explicit disclosure, preserved token/device flows, root-owned administration, Funnel rejection, and focused security regression coverage.

options.title: Keep transport-only Serve
options.body: Provision private WSS connectivity but always require OpenClaw token or paired-device authentication.

options.title: Pause core provisioning
options.body: Defer the integration until ownership and long-term policy for Tailscale-backed authorization are established.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in identity trust
recommendation.body: Support the mode with explicit disclosure, preserved token/device flows, root-owned administration, Funnel rejection, and focused security regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history is the strongest available ownership signal for generated gateway onboarding and its supported authentication contract.
